title: Decisions and work from your supervisor

goal.title: A new overall goal

action.change_representation: Another way of showing the idea

action.transfer_probe: A new problem in a different setting

ended.autonomy_recommend_only: stopped by the course team's settings

tryProblem: Try the new problem in the lesson {lesson}.
seeVisual: See the picture in the lesson {lesson}.
result.demonstrated: You showed this on your own since then.

notEvidence: None of this counts as an assessment result or changes your progress.
